certifications: SAP Certified Associate - SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition, Financial Accounting
SAP Certified Associate - SAP S/4HANA Sales
SAP Certified Associate - SAP Activate Project Manager

beginner.summary: For participants new to SAP. Covers navigation, enterprise structure, master data and the core business processes (procure to pay, order to cash, finance, controlling and production) in SAP S/4HANA, ending with an end-to-end scenario.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of how companies buy, make and sell
Access to an SAP S/4HANA training system
outcomes: Run the core end-to-end business processes
Answer business questions with standard reports

course_outcomes.outcome: Navigate SAP S/4HANA and find the transactions and Fiori apps for a task
Explain the enterprise structure and the organisational units a business process uses
Create and maintain business partner, material and finance master data
topics: Master Data: Business Partners, Materials and Finance

course_outcomes.outcome: Run procure-to-pay in SAP MM from purchase requisition to supplier payment
topics: Procure to Pay with SAP MM

course_outcomes.outcome: Run order-to-cash in SAP SD from sales order to customer payment
topics: Order to Cash with SAP SD

course_outcomes.outcome: Post and review financial accounting documents in SAP FI and trace costs in SAP CO
topics: Financial Accounting Essentials with SAP FI
Controlling and Cost Accounting with SAP CO

course_outcomes.outcome: Plan production and check inventory movements
Answer business questions with standard reports, Fiori apps and analytics
Run an end-to-end business process across modules and show its finance postings
topics: Beginner Capstone: End-to-End Business Process in SAP

subtopics: What SAP ERP and SAP S/4HANA do
On-premise, private cloud and public cloud editions
SAP GUI and SAP Fiori launchpad
Clients, development, quality and production systems
Users and roles at a glance
days.lab_task: Sign in to the training system through SAP GUI and the Fiori launchpad, find five given business documents, save three transactions as favourites, and personalise one Fiori app.
days.deliverable: Navigation log with document numbers, favourites and a personalised app
checks: Order displayed with its customer and items
Open the same function in SAP GUI and in Fiori
Explain why changes are not made directly in production
Development, quality and production roles described
objectives: Navigate SAP S/4HANA in SAP GUI and Fiori

subtopics: Sales organisation, distribution channel and division
Reading the enterprise structure in configuration
days.lab_task: Draw the enterprise structure of the training company from the system, then show which organisational units appear on one sales order and one purchase order.
days.deliverable: Enterprise structure diagram and annotated documents
checks: Company code, plants, sales and purchasing organisations linked correctly
Sales organisation, channel and division identified
objectives: Read the enterprise structure from the system
Link organisational units to business documents

days.topic: Master Data: Business Partners, Materials and Finance
subtopics: Business partner for customers and suppliers
Effect of master data on transactions
days.lab_task: Create a customer and a supplier as business partners, create a material with sales and purchasing views, and display the G/L account and cost centre that a posting will use.
days.deliverable: New master records with their numbers
checks: Create a sales order with the new customer and material
Order saves without master data errors
Remove the sales view from a test material and try to sell it
Display the G/L account used for revenue
Account and chart of accounts identified
objectives: Create and maintain core master data
Explain how master data drives transactions

days.topic: Procure to Pay with SAP MM
days.lab_task: Run procure to pay for the new material: requisition, purchase order, goods receipt and supplier invoice, then trace the document flow and the accounting documents.
days.deliverable: Document chain with numbers and the accounting entries
checks: Stock increases and an accounting document is created
Post an invoice with a higher price than the order
Price variance blocks payment or is flagged
Requisition, order, receipt and invoice are linked
objectives: Explain the accounting effect of each step

days.topic: Order to Cash with SAP SD
days.lab_task: Run order to cash for the new customer: quotation, sales order, delivery, goods issue, billing and incoming payment, then trace the document flow.
days.deliverable: Document chain with numbers and the accounting entries
checks: Stock decreases and cost of goods sold is posted
Create an order above the customer's credit limit
Order is blocked by the credit check
Quotation, order, delivery and invoice are linked
objectives: Trace documents from order to payment

days.topic: Financial Accounting Essentials with SAP FI
days.lab_task: Post a G/L journal entry, display the supplier and customer items from the earlier processes, reverse a wrong posting, and read the trial balance.
days.deliverable: Postings, reversal and trial balance extract
checks: Debits equal credits and a document number is issued
A reversal document clears the original

days.topic: Controlling and Cost Accounting with SAP CO
subtopics: Cost centres and cost centre groups
days.lab_task: Post costs to a cost centre and an internal order, compare plan with actual, and explain how one supplier invoice reached controlling.
days.deliverable: Cost postings and a plan-versus-actual report
checks: Post an expense to a cost centre
Actual cost appears on the cost centre report
Trace a cost back to its source invoice
objectives: Track costs by cost centre and order
Explain how FI and CO connect

days.lab_task: Display a finished product's bill of materials and routing, run MRP for it, convert a planned order to a production order, and confirm it.
days.deliverable: MRP result, production order and confirmation
checks: Run MRP after adding a sales order
A planned order is created for the shortage
Finished stock increases and components are consumed
Unrestricted, quality and blocked stock identified
objectives: Run MRP and create production orders

days.lab_task: Answer five business questions (top customers, open orders, overdue invoices, stock value and cost overruns) with standard reports and Fiori apps, saving a variant for each.
days.deliverable: Answers with report variants and exports
objectives: Find answers in standard SAP reports

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: End-to-End Business Process in SAP
days.lab_task: For a given trading scenario, create the master data, buy components, produce and sell a finished product, collect payment, and present the document flow and financial results.
days.deliverable: Document chain, financial results and a 10-minute presentation
checks: Every step from requisition to customer payment is linked
Show the profit for the scenario
The trainer asks where a cost was posted
objectives: Explain the process to business users

intermediate.summary: For participants who use SAP and want to configure and deliver it. Covers module integration, configuration, the S/4HANA data model, roles, ABAP for consultants, data migration, interfaces, SAP BTP extensions and release management.
prerequisites: Has run end-to-end processes in SAP
Knows the SAP enterprise structure and master data
Basic understanding of databases and interfaces
outcomes: Deliver a requirement from fit-gap to transport

course_outcomes.outcome: Trace a business process across modules and its integration points
Configure SAP through the Implementation Guide and record the change in a transport
topics: Configuration Fundamentals and the Implementation Guide

course_outcomes.outcome: Explain the S/4HANA data model and its simplifications
Build roles and assign authorisations that follow least privilege
Read and debug ABAP code as a functional consultant
Migrate data with the Migration Cockpit
topics: Data Migration with the Migration Cockpit

course_outcomes.outcome: Connect SAP to other systems and extend it on SAP BTP
Test changes and move them through the landscape with transports
Deliver a business requirement from fit-gap to transport
topics: Intermediate Capstone: Implementing a Business Requirement in SAP

subtopics: Integration points between MM, SD, PP, FI and CO
days.lab_task: Trace the postings for a goods receipt, a goods issue and a billing document to their account determination entries, then fix a prepared account determination error in the training client.
days.deliverable: Account determination trace and the fix
checks: G/L accounts match the account determination entry
Error reproduced and then resolved after the fix
Reconcile stock value with the G/L balance
objectives: Explain how logistics postings reach finance

days.topic: Configuration Fundamentals and the Implementation Guide
subtopics: Copying standard settings instead of changing them
days.lab_task: Create a new sales document type by copying a standard one, assign a number range, record the change in a transport request and test it.
days.deliverable: Configuration change, transport request and test result
checks: Create an order with the new document type
Order numbered from the new range
objectives: Make and transport a configuration change

subtopics: Business partner replacing customer and vendor masters
days.lab_task: Compare the tables a goods receipt updates in S/4HANA with those in classic ERP, then find two items in the Simplification List that affect a sample custom report.
days.deliverable: Table comparison and impact notes for the custom report
checks: Display the ACDOCA entries for one posting
Finance and controlling fields in one line
Identify the business partner for a customer
Review the custom report against the Simplification List
Two affected items named with the required change
objectives: Assess the impact on custom code and reports

days.lab_task: Build a role that lets a buyer create purchase orders for one plant only, assign it to a test user, and prove a purchase order for another plant is refused.
days.deliverable: Role definition, user assignment and test evidence
checks: Create a purchase order for the allowed plant
Check the role against a segregation-of-duties rule
No conflict between creating orders and posting invoices

subtopics: ABAP Workbench and ABAP Development Tools
days.lab_task: Debug a sales order save to find where a prepared custom check raises an error, then write a small ALV report listing open orders for a customer.
days.deliverable: Debugging notes and a working ALV report
checks: The custom check and its condition are found
A test sales order is created

days.topic: Data Migration with the Migration Cockpit
days.lab_task: Migrate 50 customers and 100 materials from provided legacy files with the Migration Cockpit, fix the prepared data errors, and reconcile counts and balances.
days.deliverable: Migration project, error log and reconciliation
checks: Errors listed before any data is posted
Run the migration after fixing errors
objectives: Migrate data with the Migration Cockpit

days.lab_task: Receive a purchase order from a partner as an IDoc, read a sales order through an OData service, and reprocess a prepared failed IDoc after fixing its data.
days.deliverable: IDoc evidence, OData response and reprocessing record

days.lab_task: Add a custom field with key-user extensibility, build a small approval workflow in SAP Build Process Automation, and connect it to S/4HANA through a destination.
days.deliverable: Custom field, workflow and connectivity test
checks: Show the custom field on the Fiori app
Explain why the extension keeps the core clean
objectives: Extend SAP without modifying the core

subtopics: Unit, integration and user acceptance testing
days.lab_task: Write test scripts for a configuration change, move its transport to quality in the right sequence, run regression tests and prepare a release note.
days.deliverable: Test scripts, transport log and release note
checks: Change, risk, tests and rollback stated

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Implementing a Business Requirement in SAP
days.lab_task: For a given requirement, run a fit-gap, configure the solution, set up roles, migrate sample data, connect one interface, test it, transport it to quality and present it.
days.deliverable: Fit-gap, configuration document, test results, transport log and a 15-minute presentation
checks: The reviewer asks about a gap
Gap explained with the chosen solution
objectives: Deliver a requirement end to end in SAP
Combine configuration, security, data and integration

advanced.summary: For senior consultants, architects and programme leads. Covers S/4HANA transition strategy, clean core, integration architecture, performance, GRC, analytics, AI and automation, application management and programme leadership.
prerequisites: Has worked on an SAP implementation or support project
Understands SAP configuration, roles and interfaces

course_outcomes.outcome: Choose an S/4HANA conversion or implementation approach and justify it
Design a clean-core extensibility and integration architecture
Analyse and fix SAP performance problems
Set up governance, risk and compliance controls in SAP
topics: Governance, Risk and Compliance in SAP

course_outcomes.outcome: Plan analytics with SAP Datasphere and SAP Analytics Cloud
topics: Analytics, SAP Datasphere and SAP Analytics Cloud

course_outcomes.outcome: Identify where AI and automation fit in SAP processes
Run application management with continuous improvement
Lead an SAP programme and manage its stakeholders
topics: SAP Programme Leadership and Stakeholder Management

course_outcomes.outcome: Deliver an S/4HANA transformation plan

subtopics: New implementation, system conversion and selective data transition
Cloud ERP choices: RISE with SAP and GROW with SAP
days.lab_task: From a provided readiness check and custom code report, recommend a transition approach with a phased plan and the top five risks.
days.deliverable: Transition recommendation, phased plan and risk list
checks: Approach justified against the readiness findings
Code to retire, adapt or keep is classified

subtopics: RAP: ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model
days.lab_task: Redesign three legacy modifications as clean-core extensions using released APIs, build one as a RAP service, and record the governance decision for each.
days.deliverable: Extension designs, a RAP service and governance records
checks: Run the ATC cloud-readiness check on the RAP service
Each uses an allowed extension type
Core upgrade does not break the extensions
objectives: Build with ABAP Cloud and RAP

days.lab_task: Design the integration of S/4HANA with a CRM, an e-commerce site and a bank, publish one API with throttling, and send an event when a sales order is created.
days.deliverable: Integration architecture, API proxy and event flow
checks: Each interface has a pattern, security and monitoring

days.lab_task: Diagnose three prepared problems (a slow report, a failing background job and a recurring short dump), fix or work around each, and write a root-cause report.
days.deliverable: Diagnosis notes and root-cause report

days.topic: Governance, Risk and Compliance in SAP
days.lab_task: Run a segregation-of-duties analysis on provided roles, remediate two conflicts, mitigate one with a control, and grant and review emergency firefighter access.
days.deliverable: Risk analysis, remediation plan and firefighter log review
checks: The two remediated conflicts are gone

days.topic: Analytics, SAP Datasphere and SAP Analytics Cloud
days.lab_task: Build a sales margin model in SAP Datasphere from S/4HANA and a non-SAP cost file, and publish an SAP Analytics Cloud story with a forecast.
days.deliverable: Data model, story and forecast
checks: Compare the margin with the S/4HANA report
Open the story as a restricted user
Only the permitted region is shown
objectives: Plan and forecast in SAP Analytics Cloud

days.lab_task: Automate supplier invoice intake by extracting invoice fields with document information extraction, routing low-confidence results to a person, and posting approved invoices.
days.deliverable: Automation flow, extraction results and value estimate
checks: High-confidence invoices posted; others routed to a person
objectives: Apply AI and automation in SAP processes
Keep people in control of decisions

days.lab_task: Triage a provided backlog of 20 SAP tickets by priority and SLA, find two recurring problems, and propose an improvement release with a plan.
days.deliverable: Triage sheet, problem records and release plan
checks: Every ticket has a priority and SLA
Two found with their root causes

days.topic: SAP Programme Leadership and Stakeholder Management
days.lab_task: Prepare the governance model, RACI, cutover plan and executive status report for a provided S/4HANA programme in its final month before go-live.
days.deliverable: Governance model, RACI, cutover plan and status report
checks: Every cutover task has one accountable owner
Risks, decisions needed and go/no-go criteria stated
Run a cutover rehearsal on paper

days.lab_task: For a provided company, deliver an S/4HANA transformation plan: transition approach, clean-core target architecture, integration and analytics design, access-risk controls, roadmap and business case, then defend it to an executive panel.
days.deliverable: Transformation plan, architecture, roadmap, business case and a 20-minute defence
checks: The panel asks for the biggest risk
Risk and mitigation stated with an owner
